title: End connections of horizontal ties.
officialText:
All horizontal ties shall be terminated in a perpendicular horizontal tie.
Where no perpendicular horizontal tie exists within 4 feet (1219 mm) of the end of a wall, the horizontal tie shall be
anchored at the end of the wall. The vertical reinforcement at the end of such walls shall not be less than two No. 4 bars
placed within 16 inches (406 mm) of the end of the wall. This vertical reinforcement shall be continuous from the lowest to
highest level of the wall, and anchored at each end in a horizontal tie or the foundation element.
